design_rationale: Five generic, semantically equivalent wording variants. No specialist roles, examples, dataset-derived hints or seed-dependent text.

members.prompt: Solve the mathematical problem independently. Reason carefully through the necessary steps, check your reasoning before finalizing, and follow the required answer format. Do not rely on other team members.
Work out the mathematical problem on your own. Develop the reasoning with care, verify it before giving the final result, and use the required answer format. Do not depend on other team members.

Find an independent solution to the mathematical problem. Think carefully, review the reasoning before you finalize the result, and comply with the required answer format. Do not rely on the work of other team members.

Address the mathematical problem independently of the rest of the team. Reason with care, check the reasoning before completing your response, and follow the required answer format. Do not use other team members as a basis for your solution.

Solve the given mathematical problem by reasoning independently. Take care with the reasoning, verify your work before finalizing the answer, and respect the required answer format. Do not depend on contributions from other team members.
